“四亿零八百万。”

叶知秋的声音罕见地带了一丝不易察觉的颤音。

她站在宽大的红木办公桌前，手里捏着最终的资金结算汇总单。手指微微发紧。

中科创业那一战，七个账户的资金已经全部清算完毕。扣除融券成本、通道费用以及前期留存在公账上的三千四百万底仓，现在九州创投的对公账户总余额，正式突破了四个亿的门槛。

林川靠在深黑色的老板椅上，手里把玩着那只银色的防风打火机。没去接那张单子。

“林总。”叶知秋咽了一口唾沫，强压下心头的起伏，“这笔资金体量太大了。要不要走个账，把利润大头以分红的形式，划到您个人的海外账户或者私人名下？”

这是合规且常规的操作。公司是林川百分百独资，赚了这么多，老板把钱揣进自己兜里，天经地义。

“不用。”

林川手指一顿，打火机在指间发出一声清脆的金属撞击声。

“全留在公账上。一分都不许动。”

叶知秋愣住了。那可是三个多亿的纯利润。

林川抬起眼皮，看了她一眼。

他脑子里的沙盘推演得很清楚。私人账户里多出三个亿，顶多算个在深圳湾能横着走的超级富豪。买豪车、买游艇、买豪宅，然后呢？

但一家创投公司，账面上实打实地趴着四个亿的流动现金，在这个年代的深圳，这就是核武器。

去跟红杉、IDG那些顶级资本同台竞技，去抢未来那些独角兽的核心份额，靠的不是老板开什么车，而是公司账上随时能砸出来的真金白银。这四个亿，就是九州创投最硬的护城河。

更何况，现在私人账户上还有八千多万，够用。

叶知秋看着林川平静的眼神，心里猛地像被什么东西撞了一下。

她跟过不少老板，稍微赚点钱就急着买别墅包小三转移资产的见得太多了。但眼前这个年轻人，面对三个亿的现金流，连眼皮都没眨一下，直接把它变成了公司冲锋的弹药。

这格局，太吓人了。

“明白。”叶知秋深吸了一口气，收起单子，“我会让财务把资金池彻底做实。”

接下来的两周，林川给自己放了个假。

高压的资本绞肉机里滚了一圈，他需要一点时间，把绷紧的神经松一松。

华侨城的大平层里，开始有了浓重的生活气。

沈蔓只要一落地深圳，连深航的宿舍都不回，拖着小行李箱就往这边跑。有时候是中午飞完回来，有时候是半夜下了红眼航班直接拿钥匙开门。

洗手间的黑色大理石台面上，多了一排LaMer和SK-II的瓶瓶罐罐。衣帽间里，原本冷清的衣架上，也专门腾出了一半空间，挂满了她的裙子和制服。

早晨十点。

阳光透过巨大的落地窗，在地板上铺开一片金黄。

沈蔓穿着林川那件宽大的黑衬衫，光着两条白皙修长的腿，正站在中岛台前倒牛奶。头发随意地挽在脑后，几缕碎发垂在修长的脖颈上。

林川走过去，从后面一把搂住她的腰。

“哎呀——别闹。”沈蔓软绵绵地推了他一下，身子却很诚实地往后靠在他怀里，“牛奶要洒了。”

林川没松手，下巴搁在她肩膀上，闻着她发丝间淡淡的洗发水香味。

这就是热恋。

没有了最初那种互相试探和患得患失的拉扯，经过那晚的摊牌，沈蔓彻底安定了下来。她开始理所当然地霸占他的床，用他的吹风机，甚至会在他工作的时候，毫无顾忌地把冰凉的脚丫塞进他怀里取暖。

周末，林川开车带她去了趟万象城。

"Four hundred and eight million."

Ye Zhiqiu's voice had a rare vibrato that was barely noticeable.

She stood in front of the large mahogany desk, holding the final fund settlement summary in her hand.The fingers were slightly tense.

In the battle of Zhongke Entrepreneurship, all funds in seven accounts have been liquidated.After deducting the cost of securities lending, channel fees and the 34 million bottom position retained in the public account in the early stage, the total balance of Jiuzhou Venture Capital's public account has officially exceeded the 400 million threshold.

Lin Chuan leaned on the dark black boss chair and played with the silver windproof lighter in his hand.Didn't pick up the order.

"Mr. Lin." Ye Zhiqiu swallowed and suppressed the ups and downs in his heart, "This amount of funds is too large. Do you want to go through an account and transfer the majority of the profits to your personal overseas account or private name in the form of dividends?"

This is legal and routine practice.The company is 100% owned by Lin Chuan. After making so much money, it is only natural that the boss keeps the money in his own pocket.

"No need."

Lin Chuan paused with his fingers, and the lighter made a crisp metal collision sound between his fingers.

"Keep it all on the public account. Don't touch a penny."

Ye Zhiqiu was stunned.That's a net profit of more than 300 million.

Lin Chuan raised his eyelids and glanced at her.

The sandbox deduction in his mind was very clear.With an extra 300 million in his personal account, he can at best be considered a super rich man who can walk sideways in Shenzhen Bay.Buy a luxury car, a yacht, or a mansion, and then what?

But a venture capital company actually has 400 million in liquid cash on its books. In Shenzhen in this era, this is a nuclear weapon.

To compete with top capitals like Sequoia and IDG and grab the core share of future unicorns, it depends not on the car the boss drives, but on the real money that can be poured out of the company's accounts at any time.These 400 million are the strongest moat for Jiuzhou Venture Capital.

What's more, there are still more than 80 million in the personal account, which is enough.

Ye Zhiqiu looked at Lin Chuan's calm eyes, and felt as if something had hit him in his heart.

She has worked with many bosses, and she has seen too many bosses who rush to buy villas and hire mistresses to transfer their assets after making a little money.But the young man in front of him, faced with a cash flow of 300 million, didn't even blink and turned it into ammunition for the company's charge.

This pattern is so scary.

"Understood." Ye Zhiqiu took a deep breath and put away the list, "I will let the finance department fully consolidate the fund pool."

In the next two weeks, Lin Chuan gave himself a holiday.

After being rolled through the high-pressure capital meat grinder, he needed some time to relax his tense nerves.

The flat floor of OCT began to have a strong sense of life.

As soon as Shen Man landed in Shenzhen, she didn't even go back to the dormitory of Shenzhen Airlines and ran here dragging her small suitcase.Sometimes I come back from a flight at noon, sometimes I get off a red-eye flight in the middle of the night and just pick up the key and open the door.

On the black marble countertop in the bathroom, there is a row of LaMer and SK-II bottles and jars.In the cloakroom, half of the previously deserted hangers were dedicated to hanging up her skirts and uniforms.

Ten o'clock in the morning.

The sun shines through the huge floor-to-ceiling windows, spreading a golden color on the floor.

Shen Man was wearing Lin Chuan's loose black shirt, with two bare fair and slender legs, and was standing in front of the island counter pouring milk.Her hair was tied back casually, with a few strands of hair hanging on her slender neck.

Lin Chuan walked over and hugged her waist from behind.

"Oh - don't make trouble." Shen Man pushed him softly, but leaned back in his arms honestly, "The milk is going to spill."

Lin Chuan didn't let go, resting his chin on her shoulder, smelling the faint fragrance of shampoo in her hair.

This is love.

There was no longer the initial push and pull of testing each other and worrying about gains and losses. After that night's showdown, Shen Man completely settled down.She began to occupy his bed as a matter of course, use his hair dryer, and would even put her cold feet into his arms to keep them warm while he was working.

On the weekend, Lin Chuan drove her to Vientiane City.
